head: 1b4cacd0f1a7f9ee5cdf365882fc3ea01e763d51
independence_gap: FX authentication-mode verification failed; native reviewer failed before returning evidence (Service Unavailable, then web search not supported). The primary runtime performed the sequential pass in the same conversation with separate frozen input/output artifacts. This is not blind review or cross-family independence.

lenses.name: Inverse regression surface
lenses.reason: Moving from selector re-resolution to a retained backend node introduces F1 when the DOM replaces an input.

lenses.name: New-domain matrix
lenses.reason: Exercised hidden, disabled, readonly, explicit CSS, stable, and replaced controls; matrix-results.json and race-results.json.

lenses.name: Resolution-rule consistency across consumers
lenses.reason: All three auth control selections use exact local refs; constructors preserve role fallback for existing snapshot refs.

lenses.name: Shell re-parse append domain
lenses.reason: No shell argument construction is changed.

lenses.name: Emission channel and one-shot latch reachability
lenses.reason: New stale error is returned through the daemon error path, but detached objects skip it and produce false success (F1).

lenses.name: Shim hermeticity
lenses.reason: No executable shim or PATH mock is added.

lenses.name: Deliberate-default check
lenses.reason: Issue 1998, existing visible-selector waits, and authored regressions establish that the hidden-first timeout is unintended.

lenses.name: Fresh-seam scan
lenses.reason: No new framework signal or callback is introduced.

lenses.name: Substrate differential corpus
lenses.reason: Real Chrome A/B compares stable, hidden, disabled, readonly and removed nodes. Detached DOM identity does not imply connected/focusable.

lenses.name: Reference-implementation oracle
lenses.reason: No getByRole, ARIA mapping, or adopted Playwright contract is changed; DOM lifetime is checked directly on Chrome.

lenses.name: New-failure-outcome propagation
lenses.reason: Reviewed caller sweep; exact refs remain local to auth. Missing later controls preserve partial form state and retry; stale path fails to reject.

lenses.name: Flag-propagation dispatch sweep
lenses.reason: Internal allow_role_fallback is true in all existing constructors and false only for add_exact_backend_node called by auth.

lenses.name: Error-path forcing
lenses.reason: Forced missing password, missing submit, and node replacement. Descriptor refusal/cancellation remain named gaps.

lenses.name: Non-destructive recovery
lenses.reason: The selected-node policy avoids role retargeting on resolution errors, but cannot prevent misdirected keyboard input after detached-node resolution.

lenses.name: Cancellation and timeout hygiene
lenses.reason: Missing-control timeouts and immediate retries exercised; transient CDP failure and cancellation are not exhaustively forced.

lenses.name: Boundary pipeline trace
lenses.reason: Traced Runtime.evaluate -> DOM.describeNode -> local ref -> DOM.resolveNode -> focus -> page-level Input.insertText. Last boundary breaks P3.

lenses.name: Substrate verification
lenses.reason: Observed actual DOM values, input-event targets, and submission, with isolated namespaces per compiled binary.

lenses.name: Dogfood the built artifact
lenses.reason: Both exact debug binaries drove CLI auth before contributor tests were trusted.

lenses.name: Newly-asserted invariant ownership
lenses.reason: The PR's safe-stale claim is false: DOM.resolveNode can return a detached object and focus can leave the previous input active.

lenses.name: Docs-behavior parity
lenses.reason: Custom CSS and normal auth contracts remain documented; hidden-duplicate fix is a repair of intended form filling. PR stale-safety prose is refuted by F1.

lenses.name: Demonstrative example
lenses.reason: No documentation example is added.

lenses.name: Choice audit
lenses.reason: No author decision trail was supplied.

lenses.name: Complexity budget
lenses.reason: Each selector materializes N matches and scans them linearly; per-poll cost O(sum of selector match counts), without nested per-node lookup.

findings.claim: Reject detached exact auth refs before keyboard input: a replaced password field can receive no input while its password is appended to username, then submitted with loggedIn:true.
findings.evidence: Repeated twice per username/password race. Parent fills replacement correctly. Head stale-user inserts into decoy; head stale-pass produces user=review@example.testlocal-test-password, pass='', submitted=true. /Users/raillyhugo/Programming/vercel/agent-browser-1999-evidence/race-results.json
findings.path: cli/src/native/element.rs:700-706 -> cli/src/native/interaction.rs:146-189, newly reached through actions.rs:12694-12703
findings.recommendation: Validate connectedness and successful focus on the exact selected node before page-level insertion; fail or safely repoll before sending credentials. Add a real-browser replacement regression that asserts actual input destination and forbids false success.
